implementation.behavior: callGeminiReceiptOcr records whether any non-credential outcome has occurred across the whole declared model operation. A later model credential rejection is definitive only when no earlier response, parse failure, unsupported-model response, transport uncertainty, timeout, or cancellation has already made the operation mixed or uncertain.

The existing model-local providerResponseReceived flag still controls whether another declared model is safe. Provider call ordering, credential ordering, model list, timeout, quota, and daily limits are unchanged.

The response-then-credential test returns definitiveCredentialRejection=false after exactly the two declared models and never calls the second credential. The existing credential-only stale-to-healthy recovery still succeeds, and credential-then-transport uncertainty remains non-definitive with its prior attempts preserved.
